title: Launch HN: Kampala (YC W26) – Reverse-Engineer Apps into APIs
originalTitle: Launch HN: Kampala (YC W26) – Reverse-Engineer Apps into APIs
content:
Kampala by Zatanna

See every request. Automate any workflow.

Kampala lets you reverse engineer anything including websites, mobile apps, and desktop apps instantly.

Features

Everything you need to reverse engineer any web flow.

Full traffic interception

See every HTTP/S request from any app or browser in real time.

Auth chain tracing

Map tokens, cookies, sessions, and multi-step sequences automatically.

Flow replay & export

Capture sequences and replay them as stable automations.

Fingerprint preservation

Maintains your HTTP/TLS fingerprint so intercepted traffic behaves identically to the original.

Kampala for Mac

Download and run on macOS today.

Kampala for Windows

Windows support is on the way. Join the waitlist and we’ll let you know when it’s ready.
